memo: v23 = structural change on v21 (LB 0.18, g4v21-3; public 0.24 prompt honghanhhh/gemma-4-baseline-lb-0-24 run 2026-10-18 + our time guard + our sibling-site checklist): ours, two stages in an ADK SequentialAgent. Stage 1 patcher (v21 steps 1-3) must edit by call 12 and hand off a FILES/SPEC/CHECK/DOUBT note by call 16, no tests. Stage 2 reviewer starts with a fresh context (include_contents none: only the issue and the note), reads get_status and git diff, reviews the diff against the issue (exact names and messages, edge cases, sync/async twins), fixes, verifies (issue example + one -k run), submits. g4v22-1 (v21 + whole-file test run) scored 0.13: longer verification in a 32k context hurt. Hypothesis: a short fresh-context review catches spec misses that the long single context loses, without extra time; LB >= 0.20 (silver 0.20, bronze 0.18 at rank 368 of 3,680 with 485 ties). Effect size: +2 tasks of ~58 needed to show. bases/v23_SOURCE.txt.
message: g4v23-1: v21 (0.18) split by us into patcher -> fresh-context reviewer (SequentialAgent)
